name: text-animator
title: Text Animator
description: After Effects style text animator: a range selector sweeps across the characters, words or lines and drives position, scale, rotation, skew, opacity, blur, tracking and fill colour of what it covers.
useWhen: You want an After Effects style animator: one selector window sliding across the text, with the properties of your choice applied to what it covers.
A flexible per-character, per-word or per-line reveal where position, scale, rotation, blur, tracking and colour can be mixed.
avoidWhen: A plain staggered entrance is enough: use split-text-chars.
You need a wiggly (noise) selector or per-glyph character substitution: this port has the range selector only.
author: RemotionUI
